svg.title: Hadley-group chest front - tulip-and-stem panel schematic
svg.desc: Stylized Connecticut River Valley joined-chest front with tulip-and-stem carving and initials field. Not a reproduction of a single accession.
svg.text: Initials often name the woman whose cloth went in - not the joiner.
Original schematic - CC0 1.0 - pair with museum plate when cleared.
